title: init_op.key_fd comment says reserved/must-be-1 but code uses it
description: In include/uapi/crypto2dev_ioctl.h, the key_fd field comment in struct crypto2dev_init_op (line 149) reads: 'reserved; must be -1 (KEY fds: asymmetric only)'. The ioctl description above it (lines 129-133) correctly documents that key_fd can be set to a KEY fd holding CRYPTO2DEV_KEY_SYMMETRIC to supply the session key. These two statements directly contradict each other. A user reading only the struct-level field comment will never attempt to use the KEY fd path, or will be misled about asymmetric vs symmetric semantics. Bad outcome: API misuse and potential confusion — users may pass asymmetric KEY fds expecting rejection based on the comment rather than the actual SYMMETRIC key path.
